item.title: Metro FM Music Awards 2026: Sam Deep leads the nominations
item.description: South African amapiano producer and DJ Sam Deep has emerged as the most nominated artist at the 2026 Metro FM Music Awards, securing nods across several major categories. The nominees were announced at The Forum in Hyde Park, in Johannesburg, on 26 February ahead of the awards ceremony at the Durban ICC on 25 April. item.title: SA: Funky Qla concludes Dark or Durban series with New EP
item.description: By Abraham Rampai South African musician Funky Qla has released Dark or Durban 3: The Last Chapter, a six-track EP marking the final instalment of his Dark or Durban series and setting the stage for his debut album in 2026. The project underscores his reputation as a compelling storyteller in the local music scene. The EP opens with ‘Isono’, featuring Zeh McGeba, which presents a raw exploration of love and heartbreak. item.title: The Brother Moves On: A Fearless Fusion of Afrocentric sound, political reflection
item.description: In today’s turbulent global political landscape, The Brother Moves On acts as a voice for those impacted by systemic failures. Their 2022 album, $/He Who Feeds You Owns You, is a provocative work that sparks conversation both in its production and its themes. The title, inspired by a speech from Burkinabè revolutionary Thomas Sankara, foregrounds questions of food sovereignty and land rights, asserting that control over your food system equates to control over you. item.title: Sarkodie, WAVVI grant 250 Ghanaian artists free Royal Albert Hall livestream
item.description: West African music distribution platform WAVVI has partnered with award-winning Ghanaian rapper Sarkodie to provide 250 independent Ghanaian artists with free access to the livestream of his sold-out Rapperholic concert at London’s Royal Albert Hall on 6 March. The initiative coincides with Ghana Independence Day and aims to support emerging artists by granting them a front-row digital view of a major international performance. item.title: DistroKid makes history by recognising maskandi, xigaza as official genres
item.description: Global music distributor DistroKid has officially recognised maskandi, a traditional Zulu music style, and xigaza, traditional xitsonga music, as distinct genres on its platform, marking a first in the international digital music industry. item.title: DistroKid, Spotify partner to support South African artists in digital music era
item.description: Global digital distributor DistroKid has entered a strategic partnership with Spotify to enhance access to digital music distribution and artist education across South Africa. The collaboration aims to support both traditional musicians and emerging independent artists across multiple genres, creating pathways for creators to share their work with global audiences. item.title: National Arts Merit Awards 2025 in Zimbabwe: All the winners
item.description: The winners of the National Arts Merit Awards (NAMAs) were announced at a ceremony held in Harare, Zimbabwe, on 28 March, recognising achievement across music, film, literature, visual arts and other creative disciplines. Music categories drew particular attention, with leading winners including Winky D and Jah Prayzah, winning two awards apiece. Winky D took home the Outstanding Music Video and People’s Choice Award while Jah Prayzah won the Outstanding Male Musician and Outstanding Album award

item.title: YouTube expands creator tools with voice replies, shorts remix features
item.description: YouTube has announced a significant expansion of its creator tools, making its voice replies feature available to all creators and introducing new AI-powered editing options for Shorts. The updates aim to enhance engagement between creators and viewers while fostering innovative content creation. The voice replies feature, first tested with select creators in December 2024, allows channel managers to respond to comments on their videos using voice recordings. item.title: Spotify introduces ‘Smart Reorder’ feature to enhance playlist transitions
item.description: Spotify has launched a new AI-driven playlist feature designed to improve transitions between tracks for Premium subscribers. The update, called Smart Reorder, automatically rearranges songs within a playlist based on their beats per minute (BPM) and musical key. The feature builds on Spotify’s custom transitions tool introduced last year, which enabled Premium users to create seamless transitions between songs. item.title: YouTube expands Premium Lite to include offline downloads, background playback
item.description: YouTube has expanded its Premium Lite subscription tier to include offline downloads and background playback, features previously reserved for the full YouTube Premium plan. The Lite tier, priced at $7.99 per month in the United States, now allows subscribers to download videos for offline viewing and continue watching content while using other apps or when their device screen is switched off.
